New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO) (2008). Global Warming Countermeasures: Japanese Technologies for Energy Savings/GHG Emissions Reduction, 2008 Revised Edition. NEDO Kyoto Mechanisms Promotion Department, Kawasaki.

FULL COPY (2026-10-07): ondan-e.pdf, 359 PDF pages, 8,795,541 bytes, English edition, 'Global Warming Countermeasures 2008 Revised Edition', NEDO preface dated 1 Sept 2008; replaces the truncated copy (moved to superseded/nedo_2008_japanese-technologies-energy-saving_truncated.pdf). The full copy is a different file/printing from the truncated one (that header declared 357 pages, 9,939,373 bytes): from printed p.21 on, pagination is shifted by +1 or +2 pages, so the 2026-10-06 page locators were corrected (intelligent burner 21->22, oxygen-enriched 22->23, HF melting 24->26, fluid coupling 26->28, rpm control 27->29, capacitors 29->31, transformers 30->32, UPS 32->34, inverter motors 33->35, exhaust fans 35->37); values unchanged. Locator: printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 8); the table of contents page numbers are off by up to 2 and were not used. Targeted pass over Sect. 2.1 (common equipment incl. cogeneration and vacuum systems), 2.2(1)-(6) and (9) (iron and steel, cement, chemicals, refining, non-ferrous, pulp and paper, glass), cross-cutting items in 2.2(7) food (dryer, GT CHP, MVR heat pump), 3.2.6 heat pumps (cost table) and 4.4 CO2 capture/storage (costs to other-values). Skipped: 2.2(8) fibres, 2.2(10) power generation, 2.2(11) water, 2.3 transport, 2.4 buildings, 2.5 Top Runner appliances, renewables, CFC/N2O sections. Main file: absolute SEC/efficiency values and whole-unit or incremental capex (capex per annual tonne derived from printed equipment + construction cost and printed plant capacity, arithmetic in formula). Every sheet's saving, cost and payback is also in _measures (87 rows, incl. the 17 kept from 2026-10-06 and new pp.11, 21, 25, 39 items). Costs: no price year is printed; most sheets reprint NEDO FY2000 'Survey of Energy Saving in Japan' (March 2001) and older ECCJ examples, so 2008 is a flagged placeholder and the true basis is likely about 1999-2000 yen; only the building gas-engine CHP cost carries a printed year (1999). Coal moisture control cost is printed in USD/t-steel. Traps: printed inconsistencies kept in notes, not resolved - hot charging saving 5,000 vs 50,000 kcal/t and payback 11.0 vs 2.0 yr (p.89); 5-stage cyclone cost ¥7.5 billion vs payback implying ¥750 million (p.120); PCI economic effect in 'million' (p.78); separator energy units (p.116); dewatering GWh/y (p.63); BOF gas recovery per t-PI vs crude steel (p.80). Heating-value basis is almost never stated (only the Makuhari gas engines and the fluidized-bed kiln table are LHV). UKERC cross-check: UKERC IS-SP3 (improved charging, £0.78/t-yr 2010) = NEDO p.65 segregated charging ¥110/t-yr (¥80 equipment + ¥30 construction per t/y) at about ¥141/£; UKERC IS-BF3 minimum £1.06/t-yr = NEDO p.74 hot stove heat recovery ¥150/t-yr at the same rate.
